summary: Comprehensive testing of Taxatie Programma (motorcycle valuation module) completed. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified all CRUD operations, report viewing, finalization, and search functionality. Google Motors endpoints verified working after server.py modifications.

integration_issues.issue: Dealer can navigate directly to /admin/taxatie-programma via URL. Page loads but shows empty state (backend correctly returns 403). Frontend should redirect non-admin users or show access denied message.

Backend: GET /api/taxatie-programma - list all taxaties (200)
Backend: GET /api/taxatie-programma/{id} - get single taxatie (200)
Backend: PUT /api/taxatie-programma/{id} - update taxatie (200)
Backend: POST /api/taxatie-programma/{id}/finalize - finalize taxatie (200)
Backend: DELETE /api/taxatie-programma/{id} - delete taxatie (200)
Backend: Dealer blocked from GET /api/taxatie-programma (403 - Admin access required)
Backend: Dealer blocked from POST /api/taxatie-programma (403)
Backend: Unauthenticated blocked from /api/taxatie-programma (401/403)
Backend: GET /api/public/motors - Google Motors public endpoint works (200)
Backend: GET /api/public/motors/brands - Google Motors brands endpoint works (200)
Backend: GET /api/google-motors/all - Google Motors admin endpoint works (200)

Frontend: Admin login and navigate to /admin/taxatie-programma

Frontend: View report (eye icon) displays full taxatie report
Frontend: Report shows all vehicle data, customer data, inspection scores, and valuation

action_items: MINOR: Add frontend route guard for /admin/taxatie-programma to redirect non-admin users or show access denied message instead of empty state

Sidebar correctly hides Taxatie Programma link for non-admin users (line 99-103 in Sidebar.js)

Average score calculation and condition label assignment working correctly
Taxatie report displays all data with proper formatting
Google Motors endpoints still working after server.py modifications

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all features working, minor access control UX issue
